questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine linguistic relativity using anthropological evidence

stimulus.body: A researcher finds that speakers of a language with many terms for snow discuss snow conditions with greater precision in conversation.

questions.stem: Which statement about linguistic relativity is best supported by the account?
